title: The Most Intelligent Open source AI model
description:
Google releasing Gemma 4 as their most intelligent open source model for free.
You can download it on your computer and devices and run it without internet.
No cloud dependency, no rate limits. 
All data stays private on your device.

This is a gold mine for anyone setting up AI models for businesses or personal use. 
There are no restrictions on commercial use.
